import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        return
    s = line.rstrip('\n')
    result = 0
    start = 0
    n = len(s)
    while start < n:
        end = start + 1
        while end < n and s[start] == s[end]:
            end += 1
        result += ((end - start + 1) & 1)
        start = end
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
